grammar_focus: 现在完成时(构成 have/has+过去分词 · 状语 just/already/never/ever/yet · for+时间段 · gone vs been · vs 一般过去时/现在进行时)
scene: 哥哥 Tom 移居国外(加拿大)· 来信讲这半年当工程师、游历多地、买车的新鲜经历

grammar_card.title: 说"已经做过 / 一直在"的事(现在完成时)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说"到现在为止已经做过、或一直持续到现在"的事。下面全用本课句子举例。

rows: 构成:have/has + 过去分词(I/you/we/they → have;he/she/it → has)
I have received a letter. / He has visited many cities.
过去分词:规则动词=+ed(receive→received);不规则要单独记(be→been / go→gone / get→gotten / buy→bought / drive→driven)
He has already gotten a job.(get→gotten)
否定:have/has + not + 过去分词
He has not felt tired yet.
疑问:Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词?
Have you ever been to Canada?
have gone(去了还没回)vs have been(去过又回来了)
He has gone to Alice Springs.(还在那)/ I have been abroad.(去过)

specialRules.rule: 状语 just / already / never / ever 放在 have/has 和过去分词中间;yet 放句末(多用于否定/疑问)
for + 一段时间(for six months);since + 过去时间点(since 1980)。注意:不能说 since three years,要说 since three years ago
有明确的过去时间点(yesterday / last year)时,用一般过去时,不用现在完成时

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — How long has Tom been in Canada?

passage: My brother Tom has moved abroad. He is now living in Canada, and he has been there for six months. I have just received a long letter from him. Tom is an engineer, and he has already gotten a good job at a big firm. He works hard, but he has not felt tired yet. Since he arrived, he has traveled to a great number of different cities. He has recently bought a used car. Right now he has driven to a small town in the center of the country. Have you ever been to Canada? Tom has never lived abroad before. He is finding this trip really exciting!

stage5.stem: "I ___ just received a letter."(主语是 I,现在完成时的助动词用哪个)
"He ___ already visited many cities."(主语 He)
stage5.stem_cn: 他已经参观了许多城市。

stage5.stem: "I have just ___ a letter from Tom."(receive 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 我刚收到 Tom 的一封信。

stage5.stem: "He has ___ to Alice Springs."(go 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他去了艾利斯斯普林斯。

stage5.stem: 下列哪个动词的过去分词是不规则的(不是直接加 -ed)?
把 just 放到正确位置:"I have had breakfast."(我刚吃过早饭)
just / already / never 在现在完成时里的位置一般是:
options: 在 have/has 和过去分词中间

stage5.stem: "___ you ever been to Canada?"(问对方去过没有)
"My brother has ___ been abroad before."(从来没有)
stage5.stem_cn: 我哥哥以前从没出过国。

stage5.stem: "The train has not arrived ___ ."(火车还没到)
"He has been there ___ six months."(达六个月)
stage5.stem_cn: 他在那儿已经待了六个月了。

stage5.stem: 选出正确的一句(他在这儿住了三年了):
options: He has lived here for three years.
He has lived here since three years.
He lives here for three years.
He is living here for three years.

stage5.stem: "Tom has ___ to Alice Springs."(他去了,现在还没回来)
stage5.stem_cn: Tom 去了艾利斯斯普林斯,现在还没回来。

stage5.stem: "He has gone to Canada" 和 "He has been to Canada" 的区别是:
options: gone=去了还没回;been=去过又回来了
gone 指将来,been 指过去

stage5.stem: 选出用现在完成时、强调"对现在的结果"的一句:
options: He has broken his leg, so he can't walk now.
He broke his leg last year.
He breaks his leg every winter.

stage5.stem: "我去年去了加拿大"(有明确过去时间 last year)应该说:
options: I went to Canada last year.
I have gone to Canada last year.
I have been to Canada last year.
I go to Canada last year.

stage6.stem: get 的过去分词,美式常用:"He has ___ a new car."
travel(旅行)的过去分词,美式拼写是:
a great number of 的意思是:
options: 许多(修饰可数名词复数)

stage6.stem: in the center of the country 的意思是:

contrast.note_cn: 中心;美语 -er 结尾 center,英式 -re 结尾 centre;同类 theater/theatre
get 的过去分词;美语现在完成时用 has gotten,英式用 has got
travel 的过去式/过去分词;美语单 l,英式双 l
